errors.evidence: Machine-generated values are incorrect; the figure shows values closer to 59% for both methods at near distance, and approximately 56% for the baseline model at far distance.
The description does not mention the presence of different shading styles in the bars, nor does it describe the relative height differences accurately.
The description does not explicitly state the chart's purpose of comparing the performance of the two models based on the distances.
